name: B cell-enriched leukocyte surface marker signatures
rationale: Members are surface/identity signatures of B cells, dendritic cells and T cells (plus butyrophilin interactions and exosome assembly); unlike the confusables, the theme carries the naive and mature B cell surface signatures.

qualifier: netrin, SLIT-ROBO, ephrin and L1 cues
name: Netrin, SLIT-ROBO, ephrin and L1 axon guidance signaling
rationale: All members concern guidance-cue signaling to Rho GTPases in axon pathfinding and fasciculation via netrin/DCC, SLIT-ROBO, ephrins and L1/CHL1, distinguishing it from semaphorin- and DSCAM-led guidance confusables.

name: Renal urate and cystine solute carrier transport
rationale: Members are SLC transporter and plasma-membrane transporter modules centred on urate (SLC22A12, SLC2A9) and cystine (SLC3A1/SLC7A9) handling, which separates the theme from neutral amino acid, hexose and organic cation transport confusables.

name: Presynaptic calcium modulation of glutamate release
rationale: All members regulate presynaptic calcium, vesicle exocytosis or glutamate/GABA transmission from the presynaptic side, with glutamate secretion regulation distinguishing it from vesicle-priming and GPCR-inhibition confusables.

qualifier: fructose, glycerol and alanine entry points
name: Glycolysis-gluconeogenesis with fructose, glycerol and alanine metabolism
rationale: Members cover glycolytic and gluconeogenic flux and the fructose, glycerol/alditol, alanine and pyruvate/oxaloacetate branches feeding it, whereas confusables centre on glycogen storage and hexose transport.

name: Centromeric sister chromatid cohesion establishment and resolution
rationale: All members concern establishing, maintaining or resolving sister chromatid cohesion, distinct from confusables on chromosome condensation, CENP-A deposition, spindle checkpoint and meiotic segregation.

name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ and PTK6 kinase signaling
rationale: Members are Hippo/YAP-TAZ density-sensing signaling plus PTK6 (BRK) signaling events; the PTK6 set is what the ERBB, MET and ALK confusables lack.

core: Epithelial anion and small solute transport
name: SLC26 inorganic anion exchange and epithelial solute transport
rationale: Members cover SLC26-mediated iodide, sulfate, oxalate and chloride exchange with aquaporin, gap junction and carboxylate transport, distinguishing it from bicarbonate/CFTR and cation-chloride cotransport confusables.

name: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell engulfment
rationale: Members concern microglial differentiation, activation, proliferation and DAP12 signaling together with recognition and clearance of apoptotic cells, unlike confusables focused on amyloid-beta clearance or macrophage fusion.

core: Cytosolic RNA sensing to type I interferon
name: RIG-I-like receptor signaling and ISG15 antiviral response
rationale: Members describe RIG-I/MDA5-TRAF-IRF signaling to type I interferon, its viral modulation and ISG15 conjugation, which separates it from DNA-sensing/TLR and interferon-response signature confusables.

name: Bidirectional Golgi to late endosome and lysosome transport
rationale: All members concern traffic between Golgi and late endosomes/lysosomes (anterograde lysosomal delivery and endosome-to-Golgi retrieval), unlike confusables on COPI and Golgi-ER retrograde traffic.

name: NOTCH1 intracellular signaling and oncogenic constitutive mutants
rationale: Every member concerns NOTCH1 ICD signaling to the nucleus, including HD/PEST/translocation mutants and FBXW7 loss, whereas confusables cover NOTCH2-4 and generic Notch transcription.

name: Positive regulation of B cell proliferation and differentiation
rationale: All members promote B cell proliferation, development or differentiation (including B-1 cells), distinguishing them from BCR signaling, germinal center and memory confusables.

name: AMPA and kainate receptor excitatory transmission
rationale: Members cover AMPA and kainate receptor activation, clustering and diffusion trapping in excitatory transmission, separating the theme from NMDA-receptor and presynaptic-modulation confusables.

name: Hyperosmotic salt stress and aldosterone-regulated sodium import
rationale: Members combine hyperosmotic/salt-stress osmosensing with aldosterone- and renin-angiotensin-linked regulation of sodium import, unlike confusables on potassium transport, hypotonic response or glomerular filtration.

name: RAS-RAF-ERK activation and phosphatase negative feedback
rationale: Members span SOS/MRAS-SHOC2-driven RAF activation and ERK inactivation by dephosphorylation and feedback, while confusables centre on RAS GAP regulation and BRAF/RAF1 oncogenic mutants.

qualifier: renal proximal tubule anion and cation carriers
name: Renal proximal tubule organic anion and cation transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated organic anion, cation and di/tricarboxylate transport tied to proximal tubule development, distinguishing them from xenobiotic export and mitochondrial carboxylate shuttle confusables.

name: Betaglycan and follistatin modulation of activin/TGF-beta signaling
rationale: All members concern extracellular co-receptor or antagonist control of activin/TGF-beta ligands via TGFBR3 and follistatin, unlike confusables on SMAD transcription, receptor mutants or gonadotropin secretion.

name: Dolichol, UDP-GlcNAc and sialic acid glycosylation precursor biosynthesis
rationale: Members mainly synthesize the lipid carrier and nucleotide-sugar donors (dolichyl phosphate, UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-glucose, CMP-sialic acid) for glycosylation, whereas confusables cover ALG/CDG glycan assembly, N-glycan processing and nucleotide-sugar transport.

core: Hepatic xenobiotic and organic anion disposition
name: Hepatic bilirubin glucuronidation and xenobiotic organic anion transport
rationale: Members cover heme/bilirubin degradation and UGT conjugation with SLCO/ABCC organic anion and drug transport (ADME), distinguishing it from bile acid synthesis and sulfonation confusables.

name: Morquio mucopolysaccharidosis (MPS IV) glycosaminoglycan degradation defects
rationale: All three members are Morquio syndrome A/B lesions in keratan and chondroitin sulfate degradation, unlike confusables covering Hurler, Hunter, Sanfilippo and keratan sulfate biosynthesis.

name: Replication-coupled cohesin loading and cohesion establishment
rationale: Members link cohesin loading, chromatin looping and cohesion establishment with DNA unwinding and replication-associated repair, unlike confusables on replication initiation, E2F programs or cohesion resolution.

name: Somitogenesis and embryonic limb and joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover somite specification and segmentation clock (LFNG) with limb, digit and joint morphogenesis; the somitogenesis members are what Hox, nodal and neural-plate confusables lack.

name: Immediate-early transcriptional response to UV and mitogenic stress
rationale: Members are early-response gene programs to UV, phorbol ester, TNF-NF-kB and growth factors with growth arrest, distinguishing them from senescence/SASP and AP-1 network confusables.

qualifier: tRNA charging, wobble modification and translation-factor hydroxylation
name: tRNA charging, wobble modification and translation-factor hydroxylation
rationale: Members cover tRNA aminoacylation and anticodon modification together with diphthamide and hydroxylation of translation-related proteins; confusables lack either the aminoacylation or the protein-modification arm.
